records.translation: 徵求多汁蟲子！

records.source: Hey there, I'm looking for a big wad o' bug guts. The juicier the better... at least that's what the crabs seem to like... 100 pieces should do the trick.
records.translation: 嘿，我在找一大堆蟲子的內臟。越多汁越好……至少螃蟹似乎喜歡那樣……一百塊應該夠用。

records.source: Collect a bunch of bug meat
records.translation: 收集一大批蟲肉

records.source: Place the bug meat in the barrel next to Willy's house.
records.translation: 把蟲肉放進威利家旁邊的木桶。
烈酒

records.source: Heard there's a spirit made out of potatoes that really packs a whallop, if you know what I mean. Mind dropping a few taters into a keg and bringing me a batch or two?
records.translation: 聽說用馬鈴薯釀的酒勁道十足，你懂我的意思。能不能扔幾顆馬鈴薯進釀造桶，帶一兩批成品給我？

records.source: Keg a few potatoes and collect 12 batches
records.translation: 把幾顆馬鈴薯放進釀造桶，收集十二批成品

records.source: Place the product in Pam's kitchen.
records.translation: 把成品放進潘姆的廚房。
皮埃爾的頂級農產品

records.source: Hello there. For an upcoming promotion, I'm thinking of offering some high-quality vegetables at a slight premium... Know where a thrifty shopkeep might find 25 gold-star vegetables?
records.translation: 你好。為了即將舉辦的促銷活動，我打算提高一點價格，販售高品質蔬菜……你知道精打細算的店主能去哪裡找到二十五份金星品質蔬菜嗎？
收穫金星品質的蔬菜

records.source: Place the crops in the empty produce box in Pierre's shop.
records.translation: 把作物放進皮埃爾商店裡空著的農產品箱。
羅賓的專案

records.source: Hey! I have an idea for a new style of bed, but I'll need 80 hardwood to make it happen. Can anyone help?                     -Robin
records.translation: 嘿！我有一個新款床鋪的構想，但需要八十份硬木才能實現。有人能幫忙嗎？                     ——羅賓
收集八十份硬木。

records.source: Add the hardwood to the stockpile in Robin's house.
records.translation: 把硬木放進羅賓家裡的材料堆。
水晶煥活

records.source: Hey! I'm going to invite some friends over to do a "rock rejuvenation" ceremony, but I'll need some crystals to channel the right energies. Do you think you could lend me a hand?
records.translation: 嘿！我要邀請一些朋友來舉行「水晶煥活」儀式，但需要幾種水晶來引導正確的能量。你能幫個忙嗎？
把一顆紅寶石交給艾蜜莉
把一顆黃玉交給艾蜜莉
把一顆綠寶石交給艾蜜莉
把一顆翡翠交給艾蜜莉
把一顆紫水晶交給艾蜜莉
水生動物數量過剩

records.source: For unknown reasons, the local population of {FishType:Text} has grown to an unsustainable level. I need a local angler to help reduce their numbers.
records.translation: 基於不明原因，當地{FishType:Text}的數量已增長到無法維持的程度。我需要當地釣客協助減少牠們的數量。
捕獲十條{FishType:Text}。
生態域平衡

records.source: For unknown reasons, the local population of {FishType:Text} has grown to an unsustainable level. I need a local angler to help reduce their numbers.
records.translation: 基於不明原因，當地{FishType:Text}的數量已增長到無法維持的程度。我需要當地釣客協助減少牠們的數量。
捕獲二十條{FishType:Text}。
河魚
海魚
湖魚
格斯的招牌歐姆蛋

records.source: {Greeting}... but I'll need two dozen eggs. Any takers?                -Gus
records.translation: {Greeting}……不過我需要兩打蛋。有人願意接下嗎？                ——格斯
收集二十四顆蛋。

records.source: Put the eggs in Gus' fridge.
records.translation: 把蛋放進格斯的冰箱。

records.source: I've got the urge to make my famous giant omelet
records.translation: 我突然想做那道著名的巨型歐姆蛋

records.source: I've got the urge to make another giant omelet
records.translation: 我突然想再做一份巨型歐姆蛋
作物訂單

records.source: {Text} Anyone who ships 100 {Crop:TextPlural} by the end of the season will earn a substantial reward from the Pelican Town Agricultural Fund.
records.translation: {Text}任何人在季末前出貨一百份{Crop:TextPlural}，都能從鵜鶘鎮農業基金獲得豐厚獎勵。
收穫一百份{Crop:Text}。
出貨一百份{Crop:Text}。

records.source: {Crop:TextPluralCapitalized} are in high demand this year.
records.translation: 今年市場對{Crop:TextPluralCapitalized}的需求很高。

records.source: Apparently, {Crop:TextPlural} are considered the latest 'superfood' in Zuzu City.
records.translation: 據說，{Crop:TextPlural}在祖祖市被視為最新的「超級食物」。

records.source: There's a new beauty craze in Zuzu City... apparently, a lotion made from {Crop:Text} is said to remove wrinkles.
records.translation: 祖祖市掀起一股新的美容熱潮……據說用{Crop:Text}製成的乳液能消除皺紋。

records.source: The Queen of Sauce was recently spotted dining on fresh {Crop:Text}. Now everyone in the world wants one!
records.translation: 最近有人目擊醬料女皇品嘗新鮮的{Crop:Text}。現在全世界都想要一份！

records.source: The Governor is holding a banquet, and his Chefs are ordering huge numbers of {Crop:TextPlural}.
records.translation: 州長要舉辦宴會，他的廚師正在大量訂購{Crop:TextPlural}。
奇異物質

records.source: I seek an extremely rare and powerful goop, known as 'ectoplasm'. It can be found in the remains of slain ghosts.      -M. Rasmodius
records.translation: 我在尋找一種極其稀有而強大的黏液，名為「靈質」。可以在被消滅的幽靈殘骸中找到。      ——M・拉斯莫迪斯
把一份靈質交給法師

records.source: Ah, it's brimming with the energy of forgotten souls... perfect.$h#$b#Now, begone! I shall require perfect silence to discern the true nature of this substance.
records.translation: 啊，它充滿被遺忘靈魂的能量……完美。$h#$b#現在，退下！我需要絕對安靜，才能辨明這種物質的真正本質。
洞穴巡邏

records.source: The number of {Monster:LocalizedName} in the local caves have made mining dangerous... for other people, not me! There's good money for anyone willing to slay 50 of them.          -Clint
records.translation: 當地洞穴裡的{Monster:LocalizedName}數量太多，讓採礦變得危險……是對其他人而言，不是我！願意消滅五十隻的人能獲得豐厚報酬。          ——克林特
消滅五十隻{Monster:LocalizedName}。
蝙蝠
灰塵精靈
骷髏
蛆蟲
社區清潔

records.source: I have an idea. There's a lot of trash in the water. Why don't we fish some out to make the valley more beautiful?                     -Linus
records.translation: 我有個想法。水裡有很多垃圾。我們何不釣一些上來，讓山谷變得更美？                     ——萊納斯
收集二十份垃圾。

records.source: Dump the trash in the recycling bin behind the train platform.
records.translation: 把垃圾倒進火車月台後方的回收箱。
給喬治的禮物

records.source: George thinks no one in town cares about him. I'd like to prove him wrong! A dozen leeks should do the trick... they're his favorite.                      -Evelyn
records.translation: 喬治覺得鎮上沒有人關心他。我想證明他錯了！一打韭蔥應該能奏效……那是他的最愛。                      ——伊芙琳
收集十二根韭蔥。

records.source: Place the leeks in Evelyn's kitchen.
records.translation: 把韭蔥放進伊芙琳的廚房。
五彩果凍

records.source: I require assistance in tracking down the rare and dangerous prismatic slime, within the local caves. Bring me a jar of its prismatic jelly and you will be duly rewarded.        -M. Rasmodius
records.translation: 我需要協助，在當地洞穴裡追蹤稀有而危險的五彩史萊姆。帶一罐牠的五彩果凍給我，你將獲得應有的報酬。        ——M・拉斯莫迪斯
消滅一隻五彩史萊姆。

records.source: Deliver a prismatic jelly to Wizard
records.translation: 把一份五彩果凍交給法師

records.source: Ah... you've returned from the hunt. I sense that you were successful!$h#$b#Now, hand over the jelly and begone! I have important work to do.
records.translation: 啊……你狩獵歸來了。我感覺到你已經成功！$h#$b#現在，把果凍交出來，然後退下！我有重要的工作要做。
羅賓的資源衝刺

records.source: I'm putting on a little promotion, just for fun. If anyone can collect 1000 pieces of {Resource:Text} in a week, they'll earn a reward. And you can keep the {Resource:Text}!             -Robin
records.translation: 我想辦個小促銷，純粹好玩。任何人只要在一週內收集一千份{Resource:Text}，就能獲得獎勵。而且{Resource:Text}可以自己留著！             ——羅賓
